summary.headline: Update Ring settings layout gains visual separation
summary.summary: A blank callout spacer separates adjacent controls in the Update Ring settings guidance.

summary.headline: Driver report access is called out explicitly
summary.summary: The driver reporting guidance adds an Accessing driver updates reports section while retaining the statement that its data is used only by driver update reports.
summary.adminImpact: Use the access section when locating driver summary, update, and failure reports.

summary.headline: Purchased-app guidance no longer directs legacy Apps and Books migration
summary.summary: The iOS/iPadOS purchased-app guidance removes the link for organizations not yet migrated to Apple Business Manager or Apple School Manager.
summary.adminImpact: Validate Apple Business Manager or Apple School Manager readiness before managing purchased apps.

summary.headline: Driver updates require a controlled evaluation and approval plan
summary.summary: The driver policy guidance now asks administrators to plan how driver and firmware releases are evaluated, approved, and deployed to reduce risk before creating policies.
summary.adminImpact: Define pilot groups, approval criteria, and release stages before creating driver update policies.

summary.headline: Driver report retention guidance is reorganized
summary.summary: Data retention is promoted to its own section; driver update data remains available for six months after the last event and older versions disappear after no device requires them.
summary.adminImpact: Export investigation evidence within the six-month retention window.
